ecology: one supervised binary-label example at x=0; labels 0/1 equally weighted; then predict the taught constant label for probe inputs x=0 and x=1
state_storage_interpretation: WRITE_LABEL into local state and read STATE during future inference
topology_storage_interpretation: store positive label by activating the edge to a seeded neighbor bit and read NEIGHBOR during future inference
scalar_cost_model: C = w_desc*description + w_state*state_writes + w_edge*edge_writes + H*(w_message*messages_per_query + w_query*query_compute)
exact_boundary: topology storage wins iff w_state > 2*w_desc + w_edge + H*w_message
interpretation: Two developmentally distinct morphology families achieve identical registered capability but occupy different raw resource regions.
Resource prices and reuse horizon can change which morphology is preferred.
Long horizons penalize topology storage when it requires repeated communication.
This is an exact calibration of Track-B frontier/phase machinery, not a novel phase law: resource-rational analysis and algorithm-selection parents own the generic cost-sensitive-selection principle.
